rules.requiredOutcome: Every retained schema migrates atomically to the current editable schema without mutating its input.
rules.currentBehavior: Schemas 1 through 8 are validated and migrated to schema 9; a failed migration publishes no partial project.

rules.requiredOutcome: The current raw project schema validates, clones, and routes as editable at the core load and migration boundary.
rules.currentBehavior: Schema 9 is the maintained writable raw-project schema and is cloned at the load boundary; this rule does not claim feature-requirement handling at the portable-archive or controller boundary.

rules.requiredOutcome: Current raw project documents carry a bounded normalized declarative feature-requirements manifest, retained-schema migrations initialize its canonical empty form without inventing requirements, and pure evaluation classifies caller-declared availability without activating project data.
rules.currentBehavior: Schema 9 validates and deep-clones manifest schema 1, canonical feature identifiers, unique requirement IDs, closed dispositions, bounded collections and strings, and rendered-fallback descriptor source kind and digest syntax. V1-V8 migration initializes an empty manifest, and evaluation reports available, unavailable, and unknown requirements with native, bypassed, or rendered-fallback effective dispositions without mutating the manifest.

rules.requiredOutcome: A current-schema portable archive retains the normalized feature-requirements manifest and every fallback-only source asset, including consistent known source-reference rewriting on copy collisions.
rules.currentBehavior: Schema 9 rendered-fallback descriptors root source metadata during project and history compaction. Current-format .scape export serializes the manifest and every project source asset, import preserves the manifest and its evaluation semantics, and copy import rewrites known fallback source IDs through the same collision map as source identity. Digest integrity is governed by the route-specific current-scape-rendered-fallback-integrity rule; arbitrary future schemas remain outside this rule.

rules.requiredOutcome: Current-format, exact-current-schema .scape routes bind every rendered fallback claim to its canonical archive asset and reject a kind or digest mismatch before publication.
rules.currentBehavior: Export snapshots the admitted project root and complete source records before asynchronous asset work and serializes the same source snapshots and bounded normalized fallback manifest used for validation. Project-root and source-record accessors and callable toJSON hooks are rejected without invocation so they cannot rewrite the admitted serialization; export then hashes every emitted source body and rejects a mismatch against the completed descriptors before manifest write or destination commit. Import and inspection bind each exact-schema-9 fallback source ID, kind, and SHA-256 to the canonical manifest asset before collision lookup or storage; import then verifies the extracted asset body size and SHA-256 before source or project publication. Inspection performs descriptor binding only and does not read or hash asset bodies. Copy import rewrites the source ID while preserving the verified digest. Future schemas return and featureRequirements is not traversed. Raw-project and stored-project loads plus runtime fallback use remain outside this route-specific integrity rule.

rules.requiredOutcome: Maintained current-schema projects are evaluated against a stable selected-product capability registry before activation, and every unavailable or unregistered requirement makes the document intrinsically read-only with a per-tab compatibility report.
rules.currentBehavior: Explicit stable broad org.soundscaper.capability feature IDs map one-to-one to the capability keys in both maintained product profiles. Only a strict true profile value is available; registered non-true capabilities are unavailable and unregistered feature IDs are unknown. The controller evaluates exact schema 9 from the actual project history that will be activated before activation side effects and makes every report containing an unavailable or unknown requirement intrinsically read-only. When an existing same-ID tab wins, its stored read-only declaration also wins over the ignored incoming document's flags. The report is retained per tab, remains deeply frozen across session metadata clones, and is exposed on the document snapshot. Future schemas return no report and featureRequirements is not traversed. This rule does not verify fallback media bytes or use fallback media at runtime.

rules.requiredOutcome: Current-format portable archive inspection evaluates maintained project feature requirements against the selected product before collision lookup, import, persistence, or activation without interpreting future project schemas.
rules.currentBehavior: The selected product is snapshotted through the shared compatibility service and injected into inspection as a provider-owned option after caller options, so a caller cannot override it. After current-format archive integrity, project-source validation, and rendered-fallback claim-to-descriptor binding, exact schema 9 is evaluated before project collision lookup and returned as a deeply frozen featureRequirementsCompatibility report. Inspection does not hash asset bodies. Future project schemas return null and featureRequirements is not traversed. This programmatic surface is the foundation for the maintained open decision; it does not use fallbacks at runtime or gate third-party activation.

rules.requiredOutcome: Every current-format, exact-current-schema archive opened through the maintained workspace/UI file routes with an incompatible selected-product feature report requires explicit compatibility-bearing consent or cancellation before import, persistence, or activation, in both collision and no-collision flows.
rules.currentBehavior: Maintained workspace/UI file-open routes use one replaceable owned request from inspection through a closed decision. A no-collision incompatible report permits only open-read-only or cancel; a combined incompatibility and ID collision permits only copy-read-only or cancel in one decision; compatible collisions permit only copy or cancel. Distinct compatibility-bearing choices fail closed against stale collision callbacks. Cancel resolves before native import, persistence, or activation. The localized dialog exposes bounded display names, stable feature IDs, availability, and declared disposition without claiming fallback verification or runtime use; incompatible decisions default focus to Cancel and support Escape dismissal and focus restoration. Acceptance passes only the existing copy collision policy into native open, after which the controller reevaluates the actual project history and enforces it as intrinsically read-only. Future-schema null reports skip this decision. The low-level native-open API retains its caller-supplied collision policy, and it and third-party activation remain outside this rule.

rules.requiredOutcome: A raw project document with a newer schema is cloned without normalization and cannot enter a mutation or overwrite path.
rules.currentBehavior: The core migration boundary returns newer objects as structured clones with readOnly=true and reason=newer-schema.

rules.requiredOutcome: A future-schema portable archive opens read-only and can be exported unchanged without ID, storage-key, binary, or unknown-field loss.
rules.currentBehavior: The archive importer traverses known collections and may rewrite project and source identity, so arbitrary future-schema .scape round trips are not yet claimed.

rules.requiredOutcome: Designated JSON opaque extension fields survive migration, clone, save, and portable archive reopen semantically unchanged.
rules.currentBehavior: Legacy unknown JSON fields are collected under opaqueExtensions.legacyV1 and JSON-compatible opaqueExtensions survive current-schema .scape round trips.

rules.requiredOutcome: Supported Uint8Array and ArrayBuffer opaque state in exact-current-schema, current-format .scape projects uses a tagged, bounded JSON encoding and round-trips byte-exactly without activation.
rules.currentBehavior: Exact schema 9 export encodes Uint8Array values, offset-view bytes, and ArrayBuffer values with a reserved tagged descriptor under lower-only limits of 256 payloads, 4 MiB per payload, 8 MiB aggregate bytes, 100,000 traversal nodes, and depth 128; other ArrayBuffer views reject. Import and inspection validate the closed descriptor schema, unique positive IDs, canonical base64, exact byte lengths, and all limits before allocating decoded payloads, then restore the declared binary type without interpreting its bytes. Reserved-tag collisions, project-container accessors, and callable container toJSON hooks reject without invocation. Other project schemas retain ordinary JSON behavior and their tag-shaped data is not traversed.

rules.requiredOutcome: Unavailable native features remain visible and bypassable, retain editable opaque state, declare requirements, and reference an audible or visible fallback when available.
rules.currentBehavior: The schema 9 manifest, evaluator, retention roots, current-format .scape paths, selected-product controller report, and current-format .scape inspection report preserve and classify declared requirements. Maintained opens now provide an actionable pre-open read-only or cancel decision, and the controller still makes an activated project with an unavailable or unknown requirement intrinsically read-only. Current-format exact-schema .scape archive fallback integrity verifies the declared digest against the canonical asset, while inspection performs pre-collision descriptor binding without reading asset bodies. The bounded current-schema .scape codec also preserves supported Uint8Array and ArrayBuffer opaque native/effect state byte-exactly without activation; other buffer views remain unsupported. Post-open visible placeholders and per-feature bypass UI, raw- and stored-project fallback-byte verification, fallback runtime use, and arbitrary future-schema archive preservation are not implemented.

rules.requiredOutcome: Video originals and reproducible proxies retain an explicit relationship, and proxy use never changes editorial time or original delivery semantics.
rules.currentBehavior: Video source originals are retained, but the roadmap proxy relationship and offline/relink model are not implemented.

rules.requiredOutcome: Freeze, unfreeze, commit, and rendered fallback state preserve the editable source and native-effect metadata.
rules.currentBehavior: Offline rendering exists, but no canonical freeze document state or cross-platform fallback contract is implemented.

rules.requiredOutcome: An unknown .scape container format is rejected before project or media persistence rather than guessed or partially imported.
rules.currentBehavior: The manifest parser accepts only formatVersion 1 and import staging rolls back source writes on failure.
